item.title: The Prop Gun Accident That Took Brandon Lee’s Life
item.description: Brandon Lee was filming The Crow in North Carolina in March 1993 when a prop gun was fired during a scene and a real projectile struck him. He died hours later from his injuries at age 28. An investigation concluded that negligence on the production contributed to the accident, but prosecutors found insufficient evidence for criminal charges.

item.title: The Lawyer Who Fell In Love With Her Client Then Faced Murder Charges
item.description: Defense attorney Keegan Harroz began representing Barry Titus while he faced domestic violence allegations involving his ex-girlfriend Tiffany Eichor. Prosecutors later accused Harroz and Titus of killing Eichor and her parents, Jack and Kaye Chandler, in 2019. Both were charged with three counts of first-degree murder and burglary.

item.title: Rachel Morin’s Last Moments Before She Was Murdered
item.description: Rachel Morin went for a hike on Maryland’s Ma & Pa Heritage Trail on August 5, 2023, but never returned home. Her body was discovered along the trail later that evening, and DNA evidence eventually led investigators to Victor Antonio Martinez-Hernandez, who was convicted of her murder and sentenced to life without parole in 2025.

item.title: The Real Housewives Star Behind A Nationwide Fraud Scheme
item.description: Jennifer Shah built her reality-TV persona around wealth and luxury while prosecutors said she helped run a nationwide telemarketing fraud scheme that targeted hundreds of vulnerable victims, many of them elderly. Shah pleaded guilty to conspiracy to commit wire fraud and was sentenced in 2023 to 78 months in federal prison

item.title: The Father Who Shot His Son’s Abuser On Live TV
item.description: In 1984, Gary Plauché's 11-year-old son Jody was abducted and sexually abused by his karate instructor, Jeff Doucet. When Doucet was returned to Louisiana to face charges, Gary was waiting at the airport and shot him as television cameras recorded the moment. Plauché later pleaded no contest to manslaughter and received probation instead of prison time.
